START_TIME = scheduled HH:MM printed in race headers; one mass start shared by several races (14:00 OC1; 14:15 SS1 men; 14:25 SS1 women; 05/10 14:15 SS2)
BIB_BOAT and STARTING_LANE = printed Boat Number/Bib (event bib, not an ICF id; maintainer t76u). PDF "Lane" running number not used.
GENDER X = SS2 Mix crews (approved t75u 1); PERSONS GENDER from CompetitorsList Men/Women headings
RESULT = printed final time; DIFFERENCE not written (marathon precedent)

Masters races 7-12, 18, 20: CATEGORY written as published in the race header ("SS1 Master 40-44 Men" -> MASTER 40-44); sheet-only exception to the contract ocean CATEGORY list (SENIOR | U23 | JUNIOR), see category_exception; ruling t114u (2026-11-02): "Add the Master categories as an exception only for this sheet."

Race 1 OC1 (t121u): EVENT OC1 (the contract ocean EVENT value reserved for OC1); the header prints no class or gender, so CATEGORY SENIOR (open class, no age band printed; the contract ocean CATEGORY list has no other fitting value) and GENDER M (all 4 athletes under the CompetitorsList Men heading).
